findingClass: An OCR amount off by a power of ten against a text or exchange value for the same IPO field.
failThreshold: FAIL per IPO and field when an OCR-marked amount differs from the text or exchange value by a ratio of 10, 100 or 1000 (within 1%). Reported by IPO, field, both values and sources.
unverifiableWhen: The staging database or the document_field_receipts rows cannot be read, or the document file was purged (OD-32).
